'''Mike Crill''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished Top 8 at [[2001 Colorado State Championship]] on 31 March 2001, according to John Arendt's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2012">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-03-colorado-states-3-31d2012/ colorado-states-3-31], DeckTech (John "Crash Beedo" Arendt, 3 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-03-colorado-states-3-31d2012/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
